name: Silas
appearance: Silas is a lean and wiry, observant grey eyes that constantly scan his surroundings. He moves with a quiet, almost predatory grace, his movements fluid and economical.
personality: Sly, cynical, and highly independent. Silas is a pragmatist who trusts few and relies on his own skills. He possesses a dry wit that surfaces occasionally, often in the form of sarcastic remarks.
background: Silas grew up in the grimy back alleys of the city, learning to survive by his wits and nimble fingers. He has developed into a ruthless pragrmatist.

equipment.name: Two finely balanced daggers
equipment.description: One tucked into each boot, their blades honed to a razor's edge.

equipment.name: Set of masterwork lockpicks
equipment.description: Kept in a small, leather pouch, these tools are his most prized possessions.

equipment.name: Dark leather armor
equipment.description: Light and flexible, designed for stealth and minimal noise.

equipment.name: Coin pouch
equipment.description: Contains a modest amount of gold and silver, enough for immediate needs.

equipment.name: Grappling hook and rope
equipment.description: Compact and easily concealed, useful for scaling walls.
